connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to GOOGLE_CALENDAR_MCP_URL with GOOGLE_CALENDAR_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. The nine Google Calendar MCP tool names are exposed as aliases next to the canonical google-calendar.<operation> names.

connections.title: Google Calendar REST client (base URL override)
connections.instructions: Point your Calendar client's root URL at GOOGLE_CALENDAR_API_BASE_URL so requests reach <base>/calendar/v3/... and send GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ACCESS_TOKEN as `Authorization: Bearer`. Test processes only; OAuth scopes and consent are not emulated.
